info.title: Vatra app API
info.description: Contract between the Vatra hub and its native apps. apiVersion 3, minClient 1 (GET /api/discover). Errors are { ok:false, code, error } with `error` in the device language (Accept-Language or x-vatra-locale).

deviceAuth.description: Paired device token (POST /api/devices/pair). Header only, never in the URL.

get.description: Any household member's paired device; room grants apply.

get.summary: How this hub can wake the app: FCM client options, Web Push (UnifiedPush) and/or Apple Push
get.description:
fcm is null when the hub has no Firebase project configured; the app then offers UnifiedPush only. webPush is always true (UnifiedPush needs no hub account). apns is true when the hub holds its own Apple Push key. relay is the Vatra Cloud push relay (url + this hub's id) when the owner enabled it, else null; apps prefer it when present.

Any household member's paired device; room grants apply.

put.summary: Register (or clear) how this device is woken
put.description:
kind fcm: an FCM registration token. kind unifiedpush: the distributor's https endpoint plus the RFC 8291 receiver keys; private-network endpoints are refused. kind apns: the iOS app's APNs device token (hex), sandbox for development-signed builds, optionally its Live Activity push-to-start token. kind relay: a Vatra Cloud push handle (from POST <relay.url>/v1/handles) for the platform, optionally a Live Activity handle; the answer carries e2eKey, the device's fresh end-to-end key (base64url, 32 bytes), returned only here and rotated on every registration. kind none: stop pushing.

Any household member's paired device; room grants apply.

post.summary: This member arrived home / left (phone geofence), or tapped a Vatra NFC tag
post.description:
Fires the Home Assistant event vatra_presence {user, member, state, source} so automations can react (lights on when the first person arrives, all off when the last leaves). A repeat of the same state within 2 minutes is accepted but not re-fired.

Any household member's paired device; room grants apply.

post.summary: Delete this member's account (in-app deletion required by the app stores)
post.description:
Needs the member's password. Erases the account, sessions, passkeys, membership, nutrition journal and AI consent and revokes every paired device of the member (this one included). The household owner and the last admin are refused (code owner_cannot_delete): deleting them means resetting the hub. A device not bound to a member gets not_bound.

Any household member's paired device; room grants apply.
